Introduction
This document outlines the Equipment Inspection I1
 procedures to be performed for Becker compressor type SV 250 max pressure/150
 discharge on a weekly basis as indicated by the W1 in the title block
Safety Precautions
Ensure
 compressor is properly isolated,
Permit must be
 issued,
Do not wear
 loose clothing near the compressor while it is running,
Wear
 appropriate personal safety equipment (Helmet and safety shoes).
Use standard
 personal safety equipment, safety Helmet, safety glasses
Environmental Recommendation
Don't throw any remains of the paint into the sewage, because it will
 cause pollution inside the sewage.
Before using a blower to clean the air filter, wear your breathing
 mask to protect lung tissues from the dust particles.
Using solvents such as gasoline and others for cleaning the oil filter is
 dangerous, it will expose lungs to very hazardous and carcinogenic
 chemicals. You have to wear your breathing mask.
Don't bum the cloth used in cleaning; collect it and send it to the dump.
Tools and Equipment
Safety
 equipment, safety Helmet, and safety glasses
Cleaning
 material, rags, air blower, and solvent
Work to be Carried Out
1. | Check oil level in compressor crank case, but only with
 the compressor at rest, the oil level should never fatl below the sight
 glass.
2. | Check for any anusual noises or vibrations.
3. | Check for leaks in piping and pipe connections
4. | Read and record gauge pressures and compressor running
 time indicator.
5. | Clean compressor room floor.
